title: Mail
subtitle: Internal messages between learners, instructors and admins.
composeSubtitle: Send an internal message to one person, several people, or a whole class.
ccHint: Visible to everyone on the message.
classGroupHint: Everyone in the selected class receives a separate copy.
subject: Subject
emptyInboxBody: Messages from other people show up here.
emptySentBody: Messages you send show up here.
emptyArchivedBody: Archive messages to keep your inbox tidy.
emptyDraftsBody: Messages you save without sending appear here.
emptyTrashBody: Deleted conversations stay here until you remove them forever.
messageNotFoundBody: It may have been removed, or you do not have access to it.
trashConfirm: It will leave your inbox and stay in Trash until you delete it forever.
deleteForeverConfirm: It will be removed from your mailbox permanently. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Mail settings
settings.subtitle: Choose which system events arrive in your inbox.
settings.courseApprovedHint: When an admin approves a course you own.
settings.classAssignedHint: When a teacher adds a course to one of your classes.
settings.courseOfflineHint: When a course you own is unpublished or archived.
settings.courseOfflineHintLearner: When a course in one of your classes is unpublished or archived.
settings.assignmentPublishedHint: When a teacher publishes an assignment for your class.
settings.assignmentReminderHint: When a teacher reminds you about an upcoming deadline.
settings.assignmentSubmittedHint: When a student submits work for an assignment you created.
settings.assignmentGradedHint: When a teacher grades your assignment and leaves feedback.
settings.classStudentJoinedHint: When a learner joins one of your classes with an invite code.
settings.courseUpdatedHint: When a course in your class is updated or published to the class.
settings.reviewQueueHint: When an instructor submits a course for public review.
settings.courseSharedHint: When someone shares a public course with you.
settings.adminNoOptions: Admins send these notifications on behalf of the platform, so there are no personal subscriptions to manage.
